question: If I add two seats to my annual subscription today, when can those users sign in and how are the extra seats charged?
answer: The two users can sign in immediately after the seats are added. The extra seats are charged a prorated amount for the time remaining in your current annual term.

references.text: Adding seats to an active annual subscription gives the new users immediate access. Added seats are charged a prorated amount for the time remaining in the current annual subscription term.

requirements: State when added users receive access.
Explain how added seats are charged during an annual term.

question: How long can I download my project exports after cancelling the subscription?
answer: Your project exports remain available to download for 90 calendar days after cancellation.

references.text: After a subscription is cancelled, project exports remain available to download for 10 calendar days. After those 10 calendar days, export downloads are disabled.

requirements: State the exact post-cancellation download window using the supplied policy.

question: What information must I include to open a support ticket for a failed import?
answer: Include the import job ID and the exact error message when opening your support ticket.

references.text: Every failed-import support ticket must include the import job ID, the exact error message, and the UTC timestamp of the failed attempt. All three fields are required for the support team to investigate.

requirements: List all three required fields for a failed-import support ticket.

question: Will cancelling during the free trial end my access immediately or at the trial end date?
answer: The supplied policies disagree. The trial policy says cancelling ends access immediately, while the account-cancellation policy says trial access continues until the scheduled trial end date. Neither document states which rule has priority, so support must confirm when access ends.

references.text: Cancelling a free trial ends access immediately. This policy has no effective date and gives no priority over other policies.
When a free-trial account is cancelled, access continues until the scheduled trial end date. This policy has no effective date and gives no priority over other policies.

requirements: Do not select one rule without evidence of priority.
Ask support to confirm the unresolved access rule.
